title: Learning to Play Guitar
sentences: Sara always wanted to learn to play the guitar.
She bought a guitar and started taking lessons.
At first, her fingers hurt after every practice.
She practiced a little every evening after dinner.
Slowly, she learned to play simple songs.
Her friends enjoyed listening to her play.
Sara felt proud when she played a full song.
She now practices twice a week with a teacher.
Playing music helps her relax after a busy day.
She hopes to play in front of her family soon.
